items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I'm almost sure he was Nat Cole's guitarist.

ctx.x: When you were mentioning the guitar player, you were mentioning a musician named Louis Gonzales that you weren't sure you were confusing him --
I'm almost sure he was Nat Cole's guitarist.
Oh, because I was going to ask you about that. I wasn't aware that Nat Cole had a guitarist of Spanish or Mexican --
At that time he still used the name Coles, with an s on it? That was his original name.
Originally he was Coles. And when he began to get popular, he dropped the S.
